mvo_1965.scope_note: Promulgated as a West Pakistan ordinance; this Pakistan Code edition carries ICT amendments. Each province applies its own amended version.

police_order.scope_note: General (federal) text of the Police Order 2002; extent: whole of Pakistan. Article 1(3) made its commencement in ICT conditional. The Islamabad High Court recorded on 17 Sep 2020 (W.P. 2407/2020) that 'The Police Order, 2002 has been enforced' in ICT. Provinces apply their own amended versions or police laws.

rti.scope_note: Applies to federal public bodies anywhere in Pakistan; provincial bodies fall under provincial RTI laws (not in the library).

workplace_harassment.scope_note: Federal Act (amended 2022); extent: whole of Pakistan. Punjab, KP and Balochistan have also enacted their own versions, which the app shows first for those provinces; Sindh operates under this Act.
